exports: Generated implementation: configured ABI traits::JsonDecode::decode_slots(&ValidatedSlots) -> error::Result<Self> for named and unit structs
test_vectors: All eight ScalarType variants select their exact frozen AOT decoder and SlotKind; u32 and i32 use checked narrowing helpers.
Complete deterministic unit-struct source vector, distinct empty named-struct construction, and repeated-render equality.
Proof fingerprint and owner checks precede exact slot-count validation, scalar reads, and default evaluation.
Dense declaration-order slots and FieldIds, skipped fields between selected fields, all-skipped structs, and zero-slot boundaries.
Required Empty emits MissingRequiredField with field context; optional Empty remains None; defaults occur only in the None arm after successful fallible decoding.
Defaulted narrowing, finite-float, UTF-8 string, and decimal decoding propagate AOT errors through ? without error-to-default conversion.
Required and optional strings copy the owner-checked decoded UTF-8 into alloc::string::String; no StrRef escapes.
Lifetimes, type parameters, const generics, existing where clauses with and without trailing commas, and concrete Default bounds without unrelated generic bounds.
Configured ABI/AOT paths, raw Rust identifiers, and local-name collisions with const generics and field type expressions.
Malformed layouts reject missing indices, gaps, duplicates, u32::MAX as a non-dense first index, and skipped fields consuming slots, with precise field indices.
A 65,537-field layout crosses the u16 index boundary without narrowing; full-width integer, finite float, and exact decimal handling remain delegated to canonical typed decoders.
